description: Set or clear the standard's document on a custom risk's control link (write — editor). A changed document clears an accepted exception's approval.

document_id.description: Organisation document whose standard this risk is an exception against (404 if not this org's), or null to clear. Required: the platform refuses a call without it (422)

risk_code.description: Custom risk code in R-ORG-N format — obtain from scf_list_custom_risks

scf_id.description: SCF control ID of an existing link — obtain from scf_list_custom_risk_controls

name: scf_update_custom_risk_control
